tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description:
Look up one company in its official register by ID: status, address, legal form, activity, source and check date.
Use it when you have an official ID. Don't use it with a name: call search_companies first.
Inputs: country FR or ES; identifier. FR: SIREN 441639465, SIRET 44163946500091, VAT FR6344163

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description:
Find companies by name in the official registers of France and Spain, 10 per page.
Use it when you know a name but no ID, then call lookup_company or verify_company with an ID from the results. Don't use it when you already have an official ID.
Inputs: country FR or ES; query, 2 to 200 characters ('

tools.name: get_company_history
tools.description:
See what changed at a company, and when: versions with the fields that changed (address, status), each with its official source.
Use it for changes over time. Don't use it for the current state: call lookup_company.
Inputs: country FR or ES; identifier as for lookup_company (441639465); optional id_

tools.name: verify_company
tools.description:
Verify a company for onboarding, KYB or before paying or signing: an outcome with reasons, checks, warning signals and a proof code you can show an auditor.
Use it to decide about a company. Don't use it for a cheap single read (lookup_company) or with a name (call search_companies first).
Inputs: c

tools.name: resolve_company
tools.description:
Decide whether a company you know (an official ID, or a name with a postcode or town) is a company in the official registers, with evidence: candidates each with a decision, linked, possible or rejected, and the reasons.
Use it to match a supplier or customer record to a register record. Don't use i

tools.name: explain_match
tools.description:
Explain why two register records are, or are not, the same company: today's decision with reason codes and evidence, stored decisions, links, and whether they share one Fuentio entity.
Use it after resolve_company or lookup_company when you must justify a match or a rejection. Don't use it to find c

tools.name: what_changed
tools.description:
List what changed at a company since a date, from every official record Fuentio holds for it: status, name, address, legal form, and the source's dated events (BORME acts), each with its source and evidence.
Use it to review a supplier or customer since your last check. Don't use it for the current

tools.name: screen_company
tools.description:
Screen a company's own names against sanctions lists: EU Financial Sanctions File, UK Sanctions List, OFAC SDN list, France's registre des gels.
Use it for KYB/onboarding checks on a supplier or customer. Don't use it to identify a company: call resolve_company or lookup_company first.
Inputs: count

tools.name: check_insolvency
tools.description:
Check a company's insolvency notices and state: France from BODACC (safeguard, reorganisation, liquidation, plans, closures), Spain from BORME insolvency acts.
Use it for credit or supplier checks. Don't use it for sanctions: call screen_company.
Inputs: country and identifier, as lookup_company (e.

tools.name: check_address
tools.description:
Validate a company's registered address against the official address base: France via API Adresse (Base Adresse Nationale, IGN).
Use it to check that an address exists and is the company's, or to geolocate it. Don't use it to find companies: call search_companies.
Inputs: country and identifier, as

tools.name: get_graph
tools.description:
Show a company's group: its parent and child companies from GLEIF (direct and ultimate parents), company to company, every edge with its source.
Use it to map a company's group. Don't use it to look a company up: call resolve_company first for its entity_id.
Inputs: entity_id (e.g. 'fu_7K3M9Q2XH4PZ'

tools.description:
Report an answer you believe is wrong or missing, so Fuentio checks it against the official source.
Use it when a result contradicts an official document you hold. Don't use it to ask questions: call the lookup tools.

tools.description:
List the countries, ID formats and official sources Fuentio covers. Free, no key.
Use it first when unsure whether a country or ID format is supported, or to explain coverage. Don't use it to check a company: call lookup_company or search_companies.
Inputs: none. Example: list_coverage().

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_company_history" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_company, what_changed, report_issue, get_evidence, watch_company, review_report · Private data: lookup_company, search_companies, resolve_company, explain_match, what_changed, screen_company, get_graph, report_issue, get_evidence, check_vat, watch_company, review_report · Public sink: explain_match, check_address, watch_company · Destructive: lookup_company, search_companies, list_coverage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_company, what_changed, report_issue, get_evidence, watch_company, review_report · Private data: lookup_company, search_companies, resolve_company, explain_match, what_changed, screen_company, get_graph, report_issue, get_evidence, check_vat, watch_company, review_report · Public sink: explain_match, check_address, watch_company · Destructive: lookup_company, search_companies, list_coverage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
